inputs.original_text: Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s call for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to raising taxes on gas companies and winding back property investor concessions, exposing a clash between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. Taylor also stopped short of echoing Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump, and would not say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership.
